description: Convenience Matters! Close to everything. Short walk to Shannon Elementary and Pinole Middle School. Near Fitzgerald Drive shopping. Old Town and Pinole Valley (Kaiser, Sprouts, Trader Joe's, PVHS) are just one I-80 exit away. Ranch-style floorplan includes primary bedroom suite and family room addition for comfortable living. Large kitchen with dining area. Fireplace in living room. Interior access to 2-car garage. Extra wide driveway and off-street carport parking. Check It Out!
risks: Outside the scanned buy box zips (likely a neighboring-zip search catch) - ARV uses a citywide comp pool (1001 comps), not this zip's own sold homes - verify local comps manually before trusting this ARV

Redfin's own automated valuation (Redfin Estimate) for this property is $632,896 - essentially the asking price - directly contradicting this model's $1,385,000 ARV (a ~$752k gap). Same root cause as other outside-buy-box false positives: 94564/Pinole isn't a scanned zip, so ARV came from a 1001-comp citywide fallback pool that doesn't reflect real Pinole home values. The listing itself isn't even marketed as a fixer ('Convenience Matters!... Check It Out!'), and exterior photos show a normal, well-kept ranch home, not a distressed property. Treat the $629,700 modeled profit as fictional.
